# MusicMix - SECOND venv "legacy-np1" for CUE-DETR and SongEval/MuQ (CPU only).
#
# Why separate: transformers==4.42.3 (pinned by upstream ETH-DISCO/cue-detr and
# required by muq 0.1.0, which imports transformers.deepspeed) declares
#   numpy<2.0, tokenizers>=0.19,<0.20, huggingface-hub>=0.23.2,<1.0
# while the core venv runs faster-whisper with numpy 2.4.6, tokenizers 0.23.3,
# huggingface_hub 2.2.0. On Windows this was solved by prepending
# .cache/cue_runtime/numpy126 + .cache/cue_runtime/site-packages to sys.path
# (tools/run_cue_detr.py:26-31, tools/run_pretrained_music_critic.py:28-40).
#
#   uv venv --python 3.11 /opt/musicmix/venv-legacy
#   uv pip install --python /opt/musicmix/venv-legacy/bin/python \
#       -r env/requirements-legacy-np1.txt --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
# then run tools/run_cue_detr.py and tools/run_pretrained_music_critic.py with
# /opt/musicmix/venv-legacy/bin/python (PYTHONPATH=src).

--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
